fields.lastSeen: Deck 12 aft rail at 01:51, from a camera still and a bar receipt at 01:38
fields.searchPlan: The Master turns the ship onto the reciprocal course; four lookouts are posted; the Coast Guard rescue coordination center is asked to coordinate air and surface assets.

items.action: Sound the alarm and mark the position on the chart
Turn the ship onto the reciprocal course
Post lookouts on both bridge wings and Deck 12
Call the Coast Guard rescue coordination center
Muster count to confirm the person's identity
Secure camera recordings and seal the cabin
Notify the shoreside Designated Person Ashore

evidence: Camera recordings for Decks 11 and 12 from 01:00
Cabin of the missing person sealed
Bar receipt and key card log for the cabin
